cards.example_en: We greet the teacher at the door.
cards.example_zh: 我们在门口问候老师。
cards.explain_zh: greet直接接人；表示向某人问好不加to。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: Hopefully, the weather will stay dry for our walk.
cards.example_zh: 但愿我们散步时天气能保持晴好。
cards.explain_zh: 句首常表示“但愿”，不表示某事一定会发生。

cards.example_en: The club imposed a sanction for breaking its rules.
cards.example_zh: 俱乐部对违反规定的行为作出了处罚。
cards.explain_zh: 可指“制裁”或“批准”，含义相反，须看语境。

cards.example_en: Economic sanctions may influence government policy, but they can also create hardship for ordinary citizens.
cards.example_zh: 经济制裁可能影响政府政策，但也可能给普通民众带来困苦。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Someone played a trick on me with a plastic spider.
cards.example_zh: 有人用一只塑料蜘蛛捉弄了我。
cards.explain_zh: trick sb into doing sth表示“骗某人做某事”。

cards.example_en: This paragraph is too long for a quick email.
cards.example_zh: 对于一封简短的邮件来说，这一段太长了。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词；写作中通常一段围绕一个中心意思。

cards.example_en: The furniture maker carved a beautiful chair from oak.
cards.example_zh: 这位家具工匠用橡木雕出了一把漂亮的椅子。
cards.explain_zh: 常与产品名搭配；决策者用decision maker。

cards.example_en: The furniture maker carved a beautiful chair from oak.
cards.example_zh: 这位家具工匠用橡木雕出了一把漂亮的椅子。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
cards.example_zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。
cards.explain_zh: 食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。

cards.example_en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
cards.example_zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: These colourful puzzles stimulate my daughter's curiosity every morning.
cards.example_zh: 这些色彩鲜艳的拼图每天早上都能激发我女儿的好奇心。
cards.explain_zh: 直接接宾语：stimulate interest表示激发兴趣。

cards.example_en: This belt keeps my trousers from slipping down.
cards.example_zh: 这条腰带能防止我的裤子往下滑。
cards.explain_zh: belt除腰带外也指带状区域，如green belt。

cards.example_en: A green belt around a city can limit urban expansion and protect nearby farmland from development.
cards.example_zh: 城市周边的绿化带可以限制城市扩张，保护附近农田免遭开发。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I baked a potato and filled it with cheese.
cards.example_zh: 我烤了一个土豆，并在里面填上奶酪。
cards.explain_zh: 复数是 potatoes，词尾加 es。

cards.example_en: Her travel diary contains a lively narrative of the journey.
cards.example_zh: 她的旅行日记生动地记述了这段旅程。
cards.explain_zh: 作名词指故事或叙述；作形容词常修饰结构、技巧。

cards.example_en: She handed me a tissue when I sneezed.
cards.example_zh: 我打喷嚏时，她递给我一张纸巾。
cards.explain_zh: 纸巾是可数名词；生物组织通常不可数。

cards.example_en: Scientists are developing new treatments that help damaged tissue recover more effectively after an injury.
cards.example_zh: 科学家正在开发新疗法，帮助受损组织在受伤后更有效地修复。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I could barely hear her above the heavy rain.
cards.example_zh: 雨声太大，我几乎听不清她说话。
cards.explain_zh: 本身含否定意义，通常不再与not连用。

cards.example_en: Engineers must invent affordable technologies that help rural communities gain access to clean drinking water.
cards.example_zh: 工程师必须发明价格可负担的技术，帮助农村社区获得清洁饮用水。
cards.explain_zh: invent是创造新事物；discover是发现已有事物。

cards.example_en: Tourism brings many visitors to our village each summer.
cards.example_zh: 每年夏天，旅游业都会为我们村带来许多游客。
cards.explain_zh: tourism通常不可数；表示一个游客用a tourist。

cards.example_en: Sustainable tourism can generate income for local communities while protecting the natural landscapes that attract visitors.
cards.example_zh: 可持续旅游能为当地社区创造收入，同时保护吸引游客的自然景观。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The pro-recycling campaign encouraged residents to separate household waste.
cards.example_zh: 这项支持回收利用的活动鼓励居民分类生活垃圾。

cards.example_en: Hold the rail on the stair.
cards.example_zh: 在楼梯上扶好栏杆。

cards.example_en: Don't hesitate to ask for help.
cards.example_zh: 需要帮助时不要犹豫。

cards.example_en: Streetlights that shine directly into homes can disturb sleep and reduce residents' quality of life.
cards.example_zh: 直接照进住宅的路灯会干扰睡眠，降低居民的生活质量。
cards.explain_zh: 发光的过去式常用shone；擦亮的过去式用shined。

cards.example_en: Training with a friend gives me motivation to keep running.
cards.example_zh: 和朋友一起训练让我有动力坚持跑步。
cards.explain_zh: 动力常不可数；具体动机可数，常接for或behind。

cards.example_en: They enjoyed a romantic dinner beside the quiet lake.
cards.example_zh: 他们在宁静的湖边享用了一顿浪漫的晚餐。
cards.explain_zh: 除爱情义外，也可指把现实想得过于美好。

cards.example_en: They enjoyed a romantic dinner beside the quiet lake.
cards.example_zh: 他们在宁静的湖边享用了一顿浪漫的晚餐。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The glutinous rice stuck firmly to my wooden spoon.
cards.example_zh: 糯米牢牢地粘在了我的木勺上。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: Choosing durable wallpaper can reduce the frequency of interior renovations and limit household material waste.
cards.example_zh: 选择耐用的墙纸可以减少室内翻新的频率，降低家庭材料浪费。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: My stomach started rumbling while I was cooking dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我做晚饭时，肚子开始咕咕叫。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“忍受”时，常用于 can't stomach 结构。

cards.example_en: There was nowhere to sit on the crowded train.
cards.example_zh: 拥挤的火车上没有地方可坐。
cards.explain_zh: 本身含否定意义：I have nowhere to go。

cards.example_en: They gather quietly each morning to pray for peace.
cards.example_zh: 他们每天早晨静静地聚在一起，为和平祈祷。
cards.explain_zh: pray to 接祈祷对象，pray for 接所求之事。

cards.example_en: They gather quietly each morning to pray for peace.
cards.example_zh: 他们每天早晨静静地聚在一起，为和平祈祷。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our school team reached the final of the championship.
cards.example_zh: 我们校队打进了锦标赛的决赛。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指争夺冠军的赛事，也可指冠军头衔。

cards.example_en: The servant carried fresh towels into the guest bedroom.
cards.example_zh: 佣人把干净毛巾拿进了客房。
cards.explain_zh: 公务员用civil servant，不能只说servant。

cards.example_en: An immigrant described the challenges of learning a new language.
cards.example_zh: 一位移民讲述了学习新语言面临的困难。

cards.example_en: Wipe away the excess paint with a clean cloth.
cards.example_zh: 用干净的布擦去多余的油漆。
cards.explain_zh: in excess指过量；in excess of指超过某数量。

cards.example_en: Consuming sugar in excess can increase the risk of obesity and other health problems.
cards.example_zh: 摄入过量糖分会增加肥胖及其他健康问题的风险。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The cleverness of a design lies in solving practical problems without introducing unnecessary complexity.
cards.example_zh: 设计的巧妙之处在于解决实际问题，而不增加不必要的复杂性。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: Our insurance covers liability for damage to neighbouring homes.
cards.example_zh: 我们的保险承保对邻居住宅造成损坏所需承担的责任。
cards.explain_zh: 责任常不可数；债务常用复数liabilities。

cards.example_en: Clear rules on legal liability encourage companies to take greater responsibility for the safety of their products.
cards.example_zh: 明确的法律责任规定能促使企业更加重视其产品的安全性。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our dog has a surprisingly short attention span.
cards.example_zh: 我们家狗狗能集中注意力的时间短得出奇。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: Researchers extract useful information from large datasets to identify patterns in household energy consumption.
cards.example_zh: 研究人员从大型数据集中提取有用信息，以识别家庭能源消耗的规律。
cards.explain_zh: 动词重音在后；名词读/ˈekstrækt/。

cards.example_en: Full implementation of the recycling plan begins next month.
cards.example_zh: 回收计划的全面实施从下个月开始。

cards.example_en: The referee showed clear bias towards the home team.
cards.example_zh: 裁判明显偏袒主队。
cards.explain_zh: bias against 指对……有偏见；in favour of 指偏袒。

cards.example_en: My sister and I arrange our desks differently.
cards.example_zh: 我和姐姐布置书桌的方式不同。
cards.explain_zh: 副词修饰动词；形容人或事物不同用different。

cards.example_en: I found a sturdy desk in the furniture catalog.
cards.example_zh: 我在家具目录里找到了一张结实的书桌。
cards.explain_zh: catalog是常见美式拼写；英式通常写catalogue。

cards.example_en: Continuous rain kept us indoors for the whole weekend.
cards.example_zh: 雨一直下，整个周末我们都待在室内。
cards.explain_zh: continuous强调不中断；continual常指反复发生。

cards.example_en: Continuous monitoring of air quality helps local authorities identify pollution sources and protect public health.
cards.example_zh: 持续监测空气质量有助于地方政府发现污染源并保护公众健康。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
